//: DETAIL CROPS for the figures on /panduan/surau (card t_e1ea03a2).
Each capture in this folder is a 1900 px full-page screenshot. Rendered at the width of the
article column on a 390 px phone (358 px), that is a 0.19x scale — a 16 px label inside the
capture lands at 3 px, which is unreadable for the committee this guide is written for.
So every figure renders a CROP of its capture, and links to the full PNG for pinch-zoom.
x/y are the top-left of the crop in the FULL capture's pixels; width/height are its size.
The rect is chosen to contain the step's red box plus the panel/row it sits in, and to keep
all four edges clear of a control so nothing is cut mid-element. Applied by
web/scripts/guides.mjs (`npm run guides:sync`), which writes the crop to
web/public/panduan/surau/detail/<file> and records its size in guidesPrivate.gen.ts.
The full PNG stays the zoom target at /panduan/surau/<file>; it is never modified.
A figure must render at >= 0.45x its natural width at a 390 px viewport, so a crop may not be
wider than 866 px (390 / 0.45) — src/lib/panduanSurau.test.ts fails if one is.
Two steps (3 and 5) mark a row that spans the whole 1568/1583 px content column: cropping to
the whole box would still be a 0.25x thumbnail, so those rects are a sub-window of the row —
step 3 shows the role select and the Hantar jemputan button, step 5 the two fee inputs and the
FPX 1.00% preview — and the full-size link carries the rest of the row.
